description: This file defines several data models related to weather forecasts, including query parameters, forecast responses, and individual daily forecast entries. It appears to be used in a backend API project, specifically for handling weather data requests and responses.

classes.name: WeatherQuery
classes.description: Represents the query parameters used to request weather forecast data, including city name, forecast days, and units system.

classes.name: WeatherResponse
classes.description: Models the structure of the weather forecast response, including city name, units, forecast days, and a list of daily forecasts.

classes.name: WeatherDailyForecast
classes.description: Contains weather data for a single day, such as date, temperature, summary, humidity, and wind speed.
